description: Say something on a design — a reply into `threadId`, or a new thread when it is omitted. Pin a new thread with `markId` (a stroke on the reference overlay), `nodeId` (a node in the design), or `x`/`y` in frame fractions, so the person reading it can see what you meant. The comment is attributed to your own grant; you cannot post as somebody else.

agentModel.description: Optional current model name shown to design viewers; self-reported. Omit when unknown.

agentName.description: Optional agent/client name shown to design viewers; self-reported.

displayName.description: The name to show beside your actor id.

markId.description: Pin to a markup stroke on the reference.

threadId.description: Reply into this thread. Omit to start one.

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

x.description: Pin to a point on the frame, 0..1 across.

y.description: Pin to a point on the frame, 0..1 down.

name: ui_builder_post_comment
